If someone really wants me at their meetup or to see what I'm up to, they should contact me personally via text/call/even email; and vice-versa. Besides, if I'm truly friends with a person, I don't need Facebook to know what's going on in their lives and what my position is relative to that. The privacy/political concerns and social steering are just another reason for me to stay away.
